mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without requiring additional triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points within one month signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as risk aversion spikes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 1 month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a collapsing housing market, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days through reduced consumer spending and earnings pressure.
failure_condition: Joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative SPX returns in >40% of cases over 3-year windows, or interaction Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) drives wage inflation and corporate cost pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as the Fed tightens policy to combat inflation.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 110.0 index points indicates robust manufacturing expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days without triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when INDPRO > 110.0, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer price inflation decline exceeding 0.3% month-over-month signals deflationary risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days as corporate revenue expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL declines > 0.3% m/m, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases above 4.5% and CPIAUCSL above 3.0% signal a dual monetary-inflation shock, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days through growth suppression.
failure_condition: Joint condition FEDFUNDS > 4.5% AND CPIAUCSL > 3.0% fails to predict negative SPX returns in >40% of cases over 3-year windows, or interaction Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer demand (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized) during late-cycle expansion accelerates corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 5-year windows.
